name: boardgame-io
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：boardgame-io。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Build turn-based games with the boardgame.io framework (v0.50.x API). Use whenever the user wants to create, extend, or debug a board/card/dice/strategy game with boardgame.io — e.g. "make tic-tac-toe / chess / a card game", "add multiplayer to my boardgame.io game", "define phases/moves/turns", writing bots, lobby/matchmaking, or any mention of boardgame.io, bgio, 回合制游戏, 桌游, 棋牌游戏, 桌面游戏开发.
